tasks.short: Inspect or test electrical assemblies and record results

steps.what: Read the assembly identity, wiring test specification and current acceptance limits
Inspect wiring and safely connect the specified test equipment
Perform resistance and operational tests on the assembly
Copy tester results to the assembly's production test record
Check result meaning, serial linkage and units; repair failed transfers
Enter visual defects and technical limitations in the test record

tasks.design: Test a native connection from the {OTHER} electrical tester to the {OPS_SYSTEM} test-record draft. Preserve safe setup, actual testing, visual defect entry, serial and result verification, and failed-transfer repair.
tasks.previous_blocker: Readings from a tester can require re-keying into the production record.
tasks.enabler_now: Connected test equipment can expose exact readings for a supported production-system import.
tasks.still_hard: Safe test setup, intermittent faults and deciding what a failed result means.
tasks.human_edge: The assembler notices physical defects and unsafe conditions beyond the tester's reading.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated result entry; testing and product-release authority do not change.

reach.learn: Test traceability, units and instrument limitations

evidence.claim: Connected test equipment can populate production test records with existing readings; this does not automate safe test setup or interpretation.

assumptions: Boundary includes physical inspection, tests and the existing recorded results used by production quality staff. Product release, shipment and engineering deviation authorization are unchanged separate transactions and earn no saving here. Shares are provisional task estimates.

The production planner supplies order and assembly serial in the existing traveller; engineering supplies the approved test specification and revision. The assembler verifies these in s1, connects the tester in s2 and runs tests in s3. {OTHER} is the electrical test-instrument category.

The tester produces serial or run linkage, test identifier, reading, units, timestamp and device flags. A native connector copies exact fields in s4. Missing serials, unsupported units or failed transfers stop for manual reconstruction within the nine retained s5 hours. No new capture, free sensor installation or inferred pass state is assumed.

Visual observations and limitations are authored manually in s6. Ordinary record saving remains one fully retained hour, ungated; the connector writes only an unapproved draft and never changes product release status. Test execution and equipment runtime yield no automation saving.
unknowns: Does the tester expose supported digital results?
Are results already linked to the production record?
Is manual repair covered by retained verification time?
research_questions: Can the connection preserve serial identity and every failed-test flag across retests?

already_counted.description: Result and linkage verification with failed-transfer repair and actual defect entry

incremental.description: Retest tester mappings after instrument or production-system changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central: 15 repeated-entry hours removed less 2 upkeep gives 13. Low: a standalone analogue meter has no compatible output, or the station is already connected; retain existing entry with no new interface upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Explain assembly procedures and techniques to colleagues

steps.what: Locate and read the current assembly procedure for the job variant
Explain assembly procedures and answer the other worker's questions
Demonstrate the technique and check the worker's understanding

tasks.design: Configure the existing {OPS_SYSTEM} job link to open the approved variant instruction in {DOCS}. Retain source reading, live explanation and demonstration; the link does not generate a procedure.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the right procedure can involve browsing a shared folder separately from the job.
tasks.enabler_now: A native job-document link can point to the approved instruction revision.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining a difficult movement and noticing when someone has misunderstood.
tasks.human_edge: The assembler uses the actual component and equipment to make the explanation concrete.
tasks.altitude: Less folder navigation with unchanged instruction responsibilities.

reach.learn: Variant control and effective peer instruction

evidence.claim: A native job-document link can reduce searching for an approved instruction while leaving reading and peer teaching manual.

assumptions: This is an actual peer explanation, including the real procedure lookup. It does not establish a routine training report, acknowledgment register or written procedure revision, and none is added.

The production job already has order identifier and variant; engineering already maintains instruction identifier and approved revision. The assembler selects the job in s1. Mapping upkeep is charged below; engineering authorship is unchanged and receives no saving.

Three of fifteen lookup hours are repeated folder navigation. Twelve remain for version checks, source reading and missing-link fallback. All 85 live explanation and demonstration hours remain. No worker transcript or monitoring profile is created, and shares are unmeasured estimates.
unknowns: Are job instructions already directly linked?
Are variant and instruction revision reliably maintained?
research_questions: Does the native link always open the correct variant and current approved revision?

already_counted.description: Read and verify the procedure and manually resolve missing links

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central: 3 navigation hours removed less 0.5 upkeep gives 2.5. Low: the instruction is already attached to the job or a one-off variant needs manual engineering clarification; retain the current process without a new link-maintenance burden.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer with supervisors or engineers about assembly work and problems

steps.what: Locate the actual job, drawing revision and known problem evidence
Confer with supervisors or engineers to review work and production problems
Clarify the agreed next activity and unresolved technical constraints

tasks.design: Configure the existing {OPS_SYSTEM} job view to link its drawing and existing problem evidence in {DOCS}. Preserve reading, discussion and agreement on the next activity; no autonomous engineering change is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing evidence may be spread across the job screen and document folder.
tasks.enabler_now: Native job links can remove a small amount of repeat navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing a process issue from a design defect and agreeing a workable next step.
tasks.human_edge: The assembler contributes direct knowledge of what happened at the bench.
tasks.altitude: A little less evidence navigation; engineering and supervisory decision rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Explain a production problem using the actual job evidence

evidence.claim: A linked job view can reduce navigation between existing evidence, without replacing a production problem-solving discussion.

assumptions: This task is the actual assembler's discussion and agreement on next activity. It does not require routine meeting minutes or an additional action register. Actual drawing changes, revised production orders or deviation approvals are performed by their authorized owners and are not silently automated or assigned any saving here.

The planner maintains the job identifier and drawing revision as existing work; the existing problem evidence comes from its actual test or observation record, unchanged by this view. The assembler selects and reads the evidence in s1. No new transcription, fault coding or evidence extraction is supplied free.

Only one of twenty preparation hours is repeated navigation removed by links. Nineteen retain reading, revision checking, missing-link repair and gathering missing evidence manually. Discussion and clarification remain fully retained. Other participants' unchanged time is not counted as focal labor or claimed as a saving.
Shares are provisional. No written output, save, message send or engineering commit is added to this conversational episode.
unknowns: Does local practice require the assembler to create an actual written handover?
research_questions: Does direct observation show repeated navigation or an existing written handover requiring separate treatment?

already_counted.description: Actual evidence reading, revision checks and manual fallback

incremental.description: Check the job's evidence links after document changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central: one navigation hour removed less 0.2 upkeep gives 0.8. Low: the problem is discussed directly at the bench or all evidence is already in the job view, leaving no removed navigation; retain the present process without new upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Interpret technical documents to determine assembly instructions and materials

steps.what: Read the work order and verify the product variant and document revisions
Expand the released bill of materials for the ordered quantity
Interpret schematic drawings and specifications to understand the assembly sequence
Reconcile material requirements with drawing constraints and repair missing expansions
Clarify unresolved document conflicts with the responsible engineer

tasks.design: Use native {ERP} bill-of-materials expansion for the verified order quantity. The assembler still reads {DOCS} schematics, checks the material output against drawing constraints and asks the engineer about unresolved conflicts.
tasks.previous_blocker: Material arithmetic can be mixed with genuine drawing interpretation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native bill-of-materials expansion can calculate exact released component quantities.
tasks.still_hard: Reading ambiguous schematics and noticing conflicts between a drawing and a released bill.
tasks.human_edge: The assembler relates a drawing to the actual assembly method and identifies missing practical constraints.
tasks.altitude: Less component arithmetic; no new authority to change drawings, specifications or materials.

reach.task: Explain a material discrepancy against released job documents
reach.learn: Bill revisions, units and engineering-change boundaries

evidence.claim: Native bill-of-materials expansion can calculate component quantities from released rows and order quantity; interpreting a schematic remains skilled work.

assumptions: This task ends with understanding the assembly and material requirements. It does not post stock issues, purchase materials, revise a bill or create a new material report. No save or approval step is invented for a read-only calculation.

The planner supplies order identifier, ordered quantity, product and variant. Engineering maintains the released bill with component identifier, quantity per parent, unit, revision and permitted configuration. Both are existing normal records; producing a new structured bill from a drawing is not assumed free.

The assembler verifies the selected order and revisions in s1. Native expansion removes the actual twenty hours of repeated component expansion and arithmetic only where performed today. Drawings and procedural meaning stay fully manual in s3.

The fifteen reconciliation hours include manual arithmetic for missing or incompatible bill rows and checking units, alternative components and drawing constraints after expansion. Missing structured bills stop for manual interpretation, not model invention. Any genuinely shared engineering escalation with another task must be owned once before roll-up.
All shares are unmeasured estimates. No model is needed for exact component multiplication, and existing system runtime earns no separate labor benefit.
unknowns: Are material quantities already expanded on the work order?
Do released bills cover the actual variants?
How much time is arithmetic rather than drawing interpretation?
research_questions: Does native expansion preserve revision, units and permitted variants across multilevel bills?

already_counted.description: Job verification, reconciliation and manual repair of missing expansions

incremental.description: Check expansion settings and variant mapping after configuration changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central: 20 material-expansion hours removed less 2 upkeep gives 18. Low: a prototype has only drawings and no released structured bill, or the work order already contains expanded quantities; retain existing document interpretation with no new configuration upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce duplicate tester entry, document navigation and material arithmetic while retaining electrical safety and drawing interpretation.
reach: Help inspectors validate serial-linked test records
Explain material discrepancies to production supervisors
role.ambitious_version: An assembler with more attention for physical quality and difficult technical interpretation, with unchanged engineering and product-release rights.
